ritual_prep_note: No need to type your question — just hold it in your heart. You can even play one-handed lying in bed: the next page has a "press and hold" mode, and it only counts while you hold.
ritual_prep_step_1_lead: Hold your phone in both hands

ritual_prep_step_2_rest: and silently repeat the question you want to ask.

ritual_prep_step_4_lead: Shake with your heart — the more sincerely you shake, the sooner a stick stands up
